headline: Motion requiring brief plain-language summaries for lengthy agenda presentations passed 2-1.
summary: The order from Ms. Lubold asked for plain-language summaries and named fonts for presentations. Members found the order complied with, and the superintendent said the matter was procedural rather than a policy issue. Members also discussed a timeline for adding items to agendas.
decisions: Found the order on presentation summaries and fonts complied with, passed unanimously.
Found the order on spelling out terms before acronyms complied with, passed unanimously.
Approved 2-1 a revised requirement that lengthy agenda presentations include a brief plain-language summary.
